messages.subject: Reminder: partner booking fees and points timing
messages.body:
Hi Daniel,

Aeroplan number ending 4207.

When you book a reward flight operated in whole or in part by a partner airline, such as United or ANA, a partner booking fee of CAD 39 per passenger applies to each booking, in addition to taxes, fees and charges.

The full number of points must be in your Aeroplan account when you book. Reward seats cannot be held, and points cannot be added to a booking afterwards. Points transferred from a bank partner such as Chase Ultimate Rewards usually arrive within minutes.

Air Canada Aeroplan
